_doc: Nguon su that DUY NHAT cho bang mau chu de nay. design-system/generate-tokens.mjs
doc MOI file *.json trong thu muc nay roi sinh ra ba dich: khoi [data-theme="ten"]
trong tokens.css, dict trong THEMES cua tokens.py, va object PALETTES cua theme.mjs.
Dung sua tay ba dich do, sua o DAY roi chay: node design-system/generate-tokens.mjs
Gia tri trong 'mau' trich NGUYEN VAN tu tokens.css khoi :root dau tien, khong go lai
tu tri nho. Gia tri trong 'ilus' trich NGUYEN VAN tu illustrations/grammar.md muc 4
(dai neutral xam CO DINH dung cho phan ket cau/thep/be tong, bat ke accent nganh la
gi). Day la chu de duy nhat hien co, dung mac dinh cho toan repo tu truoc gio, MOI
doi cach khai chu khong doi mot gia tri mau nao.
